quote.translation: Insofar as it has the character of relative contingency, positive contingency shows the structure of "the Encounter of one series with another series", and this structure was indeed the core meaning of hypothetical contingency.

regions.text: なほ目約々偶然と因果的偶然とは經驗界に屬するものとして經驗約偶然と呼ぶことが出水たが経験的であることに基いて時間的契機を有つてゐる。凝驗的積極的偶然は時間内において避逅するものである。

quote.translation: Teleological and causal contingency, we might add, could be called empirical contingency because they belong to the empirical world, and because they are empirical they have a temporal moment: empirical positive contingency is an encountering (kaikō, 邂逅) within time.

regions.text: それには同時得然と機起偶然との二つがあるが、後者は前者に還元せられるのである。

quote.translation: It takes two forms, simultaneous and successive contingency, the latter being reduced to the former.

regions.text: さうして同時性が空間性と開係してるる限う經驗界に於ける個然の核心的意味は「この場所での、この瞬間での避遍」といふ歴史的非合理性の形を取つて水なければならない。

quote.translation: And insofar as simultaneity is related to spatiality, the core meaning of the contingent in the empirical world must take the form of the historical irrationality of "the Encounter in this place, at this instant".

regions.text: 最後に離接的偶然は離接構造にあつて、可能前離接肢の全體の有つ同一性に對して、各々の可能的離接肢が示す偶然性であつた。

quote.translation: Disjunctive contingency, finally, was the contingency that each possible disjunct shows within disjunctive structure over against the identity of the whole of the possible disjuncts.

regions.text: 偶然性と可能性との開係を知るに至つて、諸様相の構成する體系内にあつて偶然性の占める位置特に偶然性が可能性に對して有つ特殊の開係を聞明する必要を生じた。

quote.translation: Once we came to know the relation between contingency and possibility, it became necessary to elucidate the position that contingency occupies within the system constituted by the modalities, and above all the special relation in which contingency stands to possibility.

regions.text: 可能性の極小が偶然性の極大である。有ることの可能性が小さいことは無いことの可能性の大きいことを意味してるる。

quote.translation: The minimum of possibility is the maximum of contingency, since a small possibility of being means a large possibility of not being.

regions.text: 離接偶然の核心意味は「無いことの可能」として「無いことの必然へ近迫することであつた。

quote.translation: The core meaning of disjunctive contingency was its approach, as "the possible of not being", towards "the necessary of not being".

regions.text: 偶然性は不可能性の無の

quote.translation: Contingency is the actual that bears as its character the nothingness of impossibility, appearing as the merely actual in the present instant as though in play.
